title: Classification and Applications of Yang–Baxter Operators
exact_target: Classify the stated Yang--Baxter operators under twists and braid-representation equivalence, and determine the geometry of their solution variety.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006485 (OWR-14299580-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mini-Workshop: The Yang–Baxter Equation and Representations of Braid Groups (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/49, pp. 2633--2672. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The source also asks whether these classifications have an impact on set-theoretic solutions; that question is retained. Its abbreviated phrase $3\times3$ operators needs a dimension convention: an operator on $V\otimes V$ for $\dim V=3$ has a $9\times9$ matrix. No silent replacement of one matrix-size convention by the other is made.
